lastChange.note: Version 61: the owner's look at first run on a test copy (18 Oct 2026), built the same day. Where saves are kept comes before choosing ("Then it must be AFTER the user selects where they want their saves"), and Choose saves is Choose what to back up. It says what a tick does for the place just chosen, and what's left unticked, before any game ("There should be locus of control"). Its groups are named for what their games are, not an action: Not synced by any launcher, Already synced by other launchers (unticked at first), Probably online-only, Games not installed; No saves found yet is gone. A step's blocks share the room left evenly, and cards side by side are the same height ("use equal block spacing if there is alot of empty space"). OnboardingScreen.
